title: ASC 905 – Agriculture
summary: Establishes accounting principles for agricultural activities, including measurement of agricultural produce and biological assets under US GAAP.
description: ASC 905 provides guidance for agricultural producers and cooperatives on inventory measurement, liability recognition, and revenue recognition. It emphasizes historical cost as the default measurement basis with a market value exception for certain agricultural products, diverging significantly from IAS 41's comprehensive fair value model for biological assets.

bannerNotice.title: Divergence from IAS 41
bannerNotice.body: ASC 905 uses historical cost as the default measurement with a market value exception, while IAS 41 requires all biological assets to be measured at fair value less costs to sell, with changes recognized in profit or loss.
